| 2026-08-25 | KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference | Srihari Unnikrishnan | 按块复用 KV 缓存，并在偏差大时选择性重算 | 直接降低 prefill 成本，对长上下文与在线推理服务很实用 | 预印本 | [arXiv cs.AI new（8 月 25 日）](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/new) |
| 2026-08-24 | How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles | Shang Wu、Catarina G Belem、Shuyuan Fu、Mark Steyvers、Padhraic Smyth | 用逻辑谜题实验观察 AI 辅助如何影响人类技能习得 | 为教育与职场「何时该用副驾驶、何时会伤基本功」提供实证 | 已接收（HCOMP 2026） | [arXiv cs.AI recent](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent) |
| 2026-08-24 | AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in Tool-Rich Language Models | Saurav Singla、Aarav Singla、Advik Gupta、Parnika Gupta | 在完整推理前先做工具路由，降低多工具场景成本 | 工具目录很大时，能让智能体调用更省、更快 | 预印本 | [arXiv cs.AI recent](https://arxiv.org/list/cs.AI/recent) |
